headline: Microsoft Reports Q3 Revenue of $92.3 Billion Driven by Azure Cloud Growth
summary: Microsoft posted total revenue of US$92.3 billion and a profit exceeding US$36.6 billion for the quarter ended in September. Profit jumped 32% despite capital expenditures increasing to US$45.2 billion, fueled by its Azure cloud business.
why: Microsoft is one of the world's largest technology companies, and its cloud computing and capital expenditure figures serve as a crucial benchmark for the software sector and corporate AI investments.

impacts.name: Microsoft Corp
impacts.why: Stronger-than-expected revenue and cloud performance boosted investor confidence in the company's financial trajectory.

why_moved: Beating market expectations on revenue and cloud growth despite heavy capital spending signals strong enterprise demand for cloud and AI services.
